neighbours.label: the token ' e' as the first piece of a lowercase word that the tokenizer splits (eaves, eardrums, epee, easterly, eons, eels, eucalyptus); e-words that are whole tokens or start with another piece (ears, east, edge, elk, eagle) stay quiet. The + pole is the capital 'E' counterpart.
fire: Swallows had built their nests under the eaves of the church.
The explosion was so loud that it ruptured both of his eardrums.
He competes in both foil and epee at the national level.
The storm weakened as strong easterly winds pushed it out to sea.
Icicles hung in a row from the eaves of the cabin.
Dinosaurs ruled the planet for eons before mammals took over.
A pair of eels slid through the reeds near the bank.
The koala climbed slowly up the eucalyptus tree.

Icicles hung in a row from the edge of the cabin.

The eagle climbed slowly above the empty valley.
